images.title: I performed a follow up service on the 5 ton Carrier rooftop unit, replacing the condenser fan capacitor that was below specifications. I also conducted a thorough deep cleaning of the outdoor coil, which was heavily soiled, to ensure proper heat rejection and condenser airflow. After the service, I operated the unit through both cooling stages, confirming proper 24 volt calls, normal compressor and condenser fan operation, and refrigerant saturation temperatures above freezing. The unit is now cooling effectively. I recommend monitoring performance and setting thermostats no lower than 72–74°F to prevent coil freezing. No further repairs are needed currently.
